Crypto Chains Must Rethink Network Effects as the Casino Gets Abstracted
> Memecoins can be a great wedge to get people in the door.
> They can even be synergistic with less speculative use cases, Solana is a testament to this.
> But the memecoin GTM is a less defensible strategy than in the past. So chains now have two choices.
> Build network effects around sustainable use cases. Or get commoditized through chain abstraction.
Source:
https://x.com/RyanWatkins_/status/2095162645074579942

tweet.text:
As the casino gets abstracted, chains that rely on it will be forced to re-think how to build network effects.

Onchain speculators are mercenaries. Apps like @fomo are driving user switching costs to zero. Today trading across chains is trivial.

The result is that the hot ball of money is more mobile than past cycles. So it’s harder for chains to build stickiness around ephemeral assets (memecoins).

Some history.

From 2023 - 2025, Solana was pretty much the only fast chain in town with a sleek mobile wallet. For a long time Phantom only supported Solana and competing chains couldn’t even come close to matching Solana’s performance.

Only when Phantom began supporting Base in November 2024 did that advantage begin to erode. Base was home to Virtuals, the leader in the AI agent bubble. Phantom’s hand was forced to support it.

Since then Solana, while still the leader in memes, has lost share in the sector. As has Base which used to be #2.

It’s easy to understand why this happened.
